notes.text: Any single channel or any combination of the eight channels can be enabled at the same time: devices with the same address on two channels collide when both channels are on. Enable one channel at a time for duplicate addresses.
evidence: Any individual downstream channel can be
selected as well as any combination of the eight channels.

notes.text: After power-up or reset no channel is selected (control register 0x00).

notes.text: Datasheet use case: identical-address targets on separate channels, one channel enabled while the others are switched off.
notes.evidence: The downstream channels are used to resolve I 2C target address conflicts.

notes.text: With several channels enabled, the targets of all enabled channels add to the bus capacitance and their pull-ups add to the controller's IOL.
evidence: If multiple target channels are activated simultaneously in the application, then the total I OL from SCL/SDA to
channels are activated simultaneously, each of the targets on all channels contribute to total bus capacitance.
